title: Default room policy gives members canChangeRoleDefinitions, so any member can grant itself any capability
description: Found 2026-11-18 verifying the interop answers (IETF notes/outbox/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-verify.md, claim 13). mimid-agent-core's default room policy (agent.rs default member role, ~L2107) gives the member role CAN_CHANGE_ROLE_DEFINITIONS (room-policy-04 §8.1.4). So a member can add canKick (or anything) to the member role in one Commit and use it in the next: the 'members can't kick' default is not real. Fix together with mimid-d4i0 (admin role for the creator): move canChangeRoleDefinitions to the admin role only; check other admin-grade capabilities in the member role; test that a member's role-definition change is refused by the hub.
close_reason: 91ece38 (branch policy-defaults, not pushed or merged): canChangeRoleDefinitions removed from the member role, admin only (decision mimid-1wgh.56); regression tests a_member_cannot_change_role_definitions and the_member_role_holds_no_admin_capability failed before the fix. Old rooms keep their roles (Limitations). Tests: 615 pass across mimid-server, mimid-agent-core, mimid-agent-jmap, mimid-agent
